description.zh:
恢复目标服务器数据库备份客户端唯一标识。
>调用[DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the database backup client on the destination server for restoration.
>Call the [DescribeUniBackupDatabase](~~DescribeUniBackupDatabase~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID。
>调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the database anti-ransomware backup policy.
>Call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
针对Oracle数据库查询备份时，对应查询可恢复的时间点中所选择记录的**reset_scn**值。
>调用[DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The **reset_scn** value of the selected record from the recoverable points in time when you query backups for an Oracle database.
>Call the [DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
针对Oracle数据库查询备份时，对应查询可恢复的时间点中所选择记录的**reset_time**值。
>调用[DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The **reset_time** value of the selected record from the recoverable points in time when you query backups for an Oracle database.
>Call the [DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
恢复数据库类型为MSSQL时，数据库恢复信息。格式为JSON字符串格式，取值：
- **name**：数据库名称
- **files**：数据库文件路径
>调用[DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The database restoration information when the database type is MSSQL. The value is a JSON string. Valid values:
- **name**: the name of the database.
- **files**: the file path of the database.
>Call the [DescribeUniRecoverableList](~~DescribeUniRecoverableList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
恢复时间点。
>调用[DescribeRestorePlans](~~DescribeRestorePlans~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The point in time to which you want to restore the database.
>Call the [DescribeRestorePlans](~~DescribeRestorePlans~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

title.zh: 创建数据库防勒索还原计划任务
title.en: Create a database anti-ransomware restoration task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-uni-restore-plan --time-point 1656957664000 --policy-id 123 --database qtc --instance-uuid ac457b30598d11ed800000163e020000 --reset-time 2022-10-29_01:06:24 --reset-scn 925702.0 --restore-info files_:_qtc_:_F:_database_qtc.mdf_,_qtc_log_:_F:_database_qtc_0.ldf_,_name_:_qtc --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateUniRestorePlan --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceUuid ac457b30598d11ed800000163e020000 --RestoreInfo 'files_:_qtc_:_F:_database_qtc.mdf_,_qtc_log_:_F:_database_qtc_0.ldf_,_name_:_qtc' --ResetScn '925702.0' --TimePoint 1656957664000 --Database qtc --PolicyId 123 --ResetTime '2022-10-29_01:06:24'
